verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe official Logseq Sync syncing up to 10 graphs across Desktop, Android and iOS, with per-graph opt-in. They state graphs are end-to-end encrypted with a user password, with file contents and names encrypted using Age/ChaCha20-Poly1305. Community users say the sync works but report bugs and early unreliability; these are reliability caveats, not a concrete contradiction of the capability. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that the vendor cannot access keys or decrypt data, independent confirmation that sync is reliable in hands-on use, and coverage of all device platforms (e.g. web)
